crossRefs.note: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and…
and the next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia…
While they were yet talking with him, the king’s eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther…
When Abram had come into Egypt, Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king…

translations.web: Then the king’s servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.
